text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wait, did the race already finish!?

—This year's "Arima Kinen." Special Week, 
Grass Wonder, and many other notable 
contenders were running.

Amidst a fierce battle for 1st place, Haru 
Urara somehow...! Has pulled off a 
magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, you know, everything's been so 
weird! Like I'm not even myself anymore!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Someone took over my body and went zoom, 
running all over the place~!

Indeed, it was a wonderful run, totally 
unlike Haru Urara's usual self... though 
it might sound a bit cruel to put it that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I'm not happy about this at all! 
Getting 1st place is supposed to feel way 
better than this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Even though we won! This is so unfair~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! I'm running in the Arima 
Kinen one more time!

True, this victory feels somewhat surreal. 
To help Haru Urara truly feel what winning 
is like, it might be good to give it 
another shot.

"To do that, I must consistently deliver 
results in graded stakes races."
choice_data_list:
Then, let's make sure to get good results 
in graded races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'm gonna run in a "Grrr-aded" 
race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right! In next year's Arima Kinen, I'm 
gonna take a fun 1st place!

"...I'll believe in Haru Urara's 
determination." With that, our training in 
the Classic Year came to an end.
